info.name: 02-Case1PlatformAbsorbs
info.description: Case-1 money model (deductFromDriver=false, platform absorbs) on a fresh card ride built in this run. Approve -> dashboard info REFUNDED, gateway refund SUCCESS; BPP refund ledger proven to have run (CUSTOMER refund invoice Paid = -rf1) while the driver wallet carries ZERO refund legs, ride earning legs untouched, and there is NO driver refund invoice and NO negative Commission invoice (the absence proofs, with commission > 0 gated). BAP refund invoice spot-checked (fully asserted in 01).
